changelog:
## v1.9.24

- New Modular Elementor Widget: Product Selector & Grid with tiered discounts, selection badges, and real-time total summary
- New Modular Elementor Widget: Product Variation Selector with image/price preview and swatch/dropdown UI
- New Modular Elementor Widget: Embedded Checkout Form with direct AJAX submission
- New: Order Tagging System automatically tags orders with 'WC Smart Checkout' / 'WC SC' and displays admin badges in WooCommerce orders list (Standard & HPOS)
- Auto-updater: 1-click update support directly from WordPress admin dashboard
